title: Coevolutionary dynamics of 53BP1 and its impact on TP53 interaction for DNA damage repair.
authors: Kumari, Komal; Rai, Gyan Prakash; Shriya, Srishti; Khan, Nooruddin; Ola, Mohammad Shamsul; Shanker, Asheesh; Haque, Rizwanul
one_liner_zh: 该文研究53BP1与p53蛋白-蛋白互作及共进化对结合亲和力的影响，虽涉及DNA损伤修复但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法为序列分析与蛋白-蛋白对接，缺乏TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The p53-binding protein 1 (53BP1) is essential for DNA damage repair via non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) and plays a crucial role in maintaining genomic stability by interacting with the tumor suppressor protein p53, a key regulator of the DNA damage response (DDR). This study investigates the role of coevolution within 53BP1 and its impact on structural integrity and binding affinity with p53. Through multiple sequence alignment and phylogenetic analysis, we identified 72 coevolving groups of amino acid residues, five of which were mapped to the BRCT domain of 53BP1. Mutational effects on these residues were assessed using point mutation mapping and stability analysis via DynaMut, with a detailed evaluation of groups 12 and 16. Docking studies revealed that coevolution-induced modifications enhanced 53BP1-p53 interactions, with group 12 exhibiting the highest binding affinity (-9.9 kcal/mol), followed by group 16 (-9 kcal/mol), both outperforming the wild-type (-8.9 kcal/mol). These modifications resulted in novel interactions that contributed to overall structural stability. Our findings highlight the significance of coevolution in shaping protein-protein interactions and maintaining the structural and functional integrity of 53BP1 protein.
abstract_zh: p53结合蛋白1（53BP1）通过非同源末端连接（NHEJ）途径对DNA损伤修复至关重要，并通过与肿瘤抑制蛋白p53（DNA损伤反应（DDR）的关键调控因子）相互作用，在维持基因组稳定性中发挥关键作用。本研究探讨了53BP1内共进化的作用及其对结构完整性和与p53结合亲和力的影响。通过多序列比对和系统发育分析，我们鉴定了72组共进化的氨基酸残基，其中5组映射到53BP1的BRCT结构域。利用点突变映射和DynaMut稳定性分析评估了这些残基的突变效应，并对第12组和第16组进行了详细评估。对接研究表明，共进化诱导的修饰增强了53BP1-p53相互作用，其中第12组表现出最高的结合亲和力（-9.9 kcal/mol），其次是第16组（-9 kcal/mol），两者均优于野生型（-8.9 kcal/mol）。这些修饰产生了新的相互作用，有助于整体结构稳定性。我们的发现强调了共进化在塑造蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用以及维持53BP1蛋白结构和功能完整性中的重要性。
